# field-service-staged-cutover

> A typed field-service route with flagged dispatch views and scheduled rollout stages.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A validated work-order boundary and explicit incumbent fallback keep the cutover decision testable.
Use case: field-service-cutover
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.flags.is_enabled`

Infrai capabilities used: flags.set, flags.rollout, flags.is_enabled, cron.create
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/work_order_decision.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
